description: FanDuel Sportsbook (New Jersey) game lines for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA and college football/basketball: each listed game with FanDuel event ID, away/home team, start time and the moneyline, spread (puck line in NHL) and total, every price in American and decimal odds with the line. Read from the JSON FanDuel's own web app loads; only games FanDuel currently lists, no props or futures. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_espn_standings when you need ESPN standings for NBA, NFL, MLB or NHL, by conference; sports_sportsline when you need SportsLine odds board: for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
